tasks.label: align-login-and-extract-token
tasks.command:
powershell -NoProfile -Command "$file='test-all.ps1'; (Get-Content $file) -replace '\{@\s*name\s*=\s*"Auth Login";[^\}]+\}', '@{ name = "Auth Login"; method = "POST"; url = "/api/auth/login"; expect = 200; auth = $false; body = @{email="test@example.com";password="Pass123!"} }' | Set-Content $file; $c=Get-Content $file -Raw; $needle='        # If this is Auth Login and success, extract token'; if($c -notmatch [regex]::Escape($needle)){}; $c=$c -replace '        \$response = Invoke-WebRequest @params?
        \$status\s+=\s+\$response\.StatusCode?
?
        # If this is Auth Login and success, extract token','        $response = Invoke-WebRequest @params`n        $status   = $response.StatusCode`n`n        # If this is Auth Register and success, extract token`n        if ($test.name -eq "Auth Register" -and ($status -eq 201 -or $status -eq 200)) {`n            try {`n                $json = $response.Content | ConvertFrom-Json`n                if ($json.token) {`n                    $token = $json.token`n                    Write-Host " [Token: $($token.Substring(0, 20))...]" -ForegroundColor Gray -NoNewline`n                }`n            } catch {}`n        }`n`n        # If this is Auth Login and success, extract token'; Set-Content $file $c; Write-Host 'Updated test-all.ps1' -ForegroundColor Green"
